name: pi-hermes-gateway
description: Local unpublished workspace for a pluggable Pi messaging gateway. Package names are provisional identifiers, not npm-scope claims.

scripts.build: npm run build -w pi-hermes-gateway-protocol && npm run build -w pi-hermes-gateway-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w pi-hermes-gateway-protocol && npm run typecheck -w pi-hermes-gateway-protocol && npm run typecheck -w pi-hermes-gateway-core
scripts.test: npm run test -w pi-hermes-gateway-protocol && npm run test -w pi-hermes-gateway-core
